# Vault

> Capacity-bounded secure storage (a bank).

- Package: `Vault` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md), [Item](Item.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Vault")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Vault")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Vault`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/VaultService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Vault = GaxiaServer.Vault
```

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Vault.OnChanged` — `Signal<Player, string, number>`
  (player, itemId, newCount) after a Deposit / Withdraw changed a slot (newCount 0 = slot emptied)
